head: LightCue: RGB LED strip remote app for iPhone, no account needed
dek: LightCue is a $2.99 iPhone and iPad remote for Bluetooth LED strips, light bars and bulbs that work with ELK-BLEDOM controllers. It was #97 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 25 November.
details: You set power, colour and brightness per light, save colours and build scenes that fade over a set time, and it can correct strips that look too blue. It works with Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight and the Action button, and backups go to a file. It runs offline with no account or analytics and doesn't work with Philips Hue, Govee or LIFX. Made by Dave Rogers, out since 9 November, it needs iOS 26.5 or later.
where: iPhone and iPad, iOS 26.5 or later, App Store, $2.99
means: If your LED strip came with a basic Bluetooth controller, LightCue is a paid alternative to its own app, with scenes and Siri control.
todo: Check that your lights use an ELK-BLEDOM-compatible controller before buying; the app has a Demo Mode to look around.
